newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Trading halt on Reef Casino after loss.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Trading halt on Reef Casino after loss.

text.p: Trade in Reef Casino Trust shares was halted on Monday after the company announced late on Friday it had made a surprise loss of A$5.9 million in the three months to September 30.
The Cairns-based casino and hotel operator said the opening of the Reef Hotel Casino had coincided with a disappointing period for tourism in Cairns.
"Whilst the hotel revenue has approached budget in the three months to September, Casino revenue has been below budget estimates with a significant shortfall in rental to the Trust," Reef said.
Reef had originally estimated a profit of A$900,000 in the September quarter.
"It is pointed out that A$4 million of this loss was incurred in August when Casino gross gaining revenue was affected by abnormal junket gaming losses," it said.
On Monday, Reef said it would take initiatives in association with its lessee Casinos Austria International Ltd.
"The Trust expects that these arrangements will be finalised before the opening for business on Tuesday, 15 October 1996," it said.
Reef's shares closed down one cent at 52 cents on Friday.
